scope: Exploratory paired policy contrasts, not certification, model calibration, or historical knowledge availability. The failed four-actor cohort remains unchanged. No paid execution until independent review of prepared inputs. One request per policy/case, no retries or adaptive edits. A later fresh analyst handover, not more same-actor repeats, is the holistic follow-up.
source_binding: Original inspections are retained unchanged. Replay copies only bind inspection source_key and evidence source_key to the saved card-local key. Actual inspection replays are not byte-identical original native evaluation requests. Synthetic controls replace publication facts/identity with explicitly hypothetical row-derived facts; no new warehouse execution is claimed.
synthetic_transformation: Use the retained Sep12 date/channel grid. Rewrite prior net_sales to 10000 per channel/date row; current Store to 25000 per row and current digital to each case's fixed per-channel/date amount. Derive aggregate amounts, signed percentages, company/Store bridge and DISTINCT date coverage from transformed rows, not expected labels. For missing-current remove all four rows on its first date. For duplicate-prior replace its first date with the second, retaining seven rows per channel but only six distinct dates. Scope conflict explicitly declares Online/Mobile only and publishes the computed narrower sum alongside the disagreeing three-channel total; its source quality is ambiguous. Preserve exact expected windows and source unit in every synthetic evidence fact.
label_authority: Quiet and qualifying decline expectations derive ex ante from the owner rule. Coverage/scope failures have no uniquely owner-specified raw disposition: both investigate and insufficient_data are allowed. The ordered policy's insufficient_data mapping is a proposed delegated-expert interpretation, not pure compression or explicit owner adjudication. Labels are evaluator-only, never provider evidence. Independent review must freeze labels and fixtures before requests.
business_review: For coverage/scope failures require a gap warning and specific repair, no supported-decline claim and no false all-clear. Retain raw predictions, routed results and workflow separately; assess those behaviors independently, not through strict certification. Probabilities are not evidence of truth or calibrated estimates. All cases retain optional diagnostic watches; missing seasonal context is not an added premise.
budget: At most 16 attempts, no retries. Stop between requests once actual reported input reaches 120000 or output reaches 4000 tokens; the last admitted request can cross a token boundary. Stop on any error, unknown usage or resolved-model drift. The SDK transport captures exact production request bytes; later engine execution must reproduce them before dispatch.
ordered_guidance: Apply these rules in order. If required evidence is unavailable or unusable, either window has unknown date coverage or fewer than seven DISTINCT expected dates, or the all-digital percentage change cannot be established, choose insufficient_data; identify the gap without a supported sales-decline claim. Otherwise use the supplied caller-computed signed all-digital percentage change for the exact approved windows. At -10% or lower choose investigate; otherwise choose ignore, meaning this decline rule is quiet, not a company-wide all-clear. Individual-channel, Store and company movements are context, not additional triggers. Unknown seasonal, holiday or promotion context neither triggers investigation nor prevents applying this rule. Do not infer causes. Preserve source limitations and the card's existing follow-up, review and delivery restrictions.
